findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_badge_embed, list_traction_reports · Private data: get_evidence, compare_subjects, ask_attify, lookup_vendor, explain_provenance, get_program_status · Public sink: get_index, get_traction_report, get_monthly_verdict, get_agent_outcomes, compare_my_agents, get_renewal_packs, get_badge_embed, list_traction_reports, get_ingest_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_badge_embed, list_traction_reports · Private data: get_evidence, compare_subjects, ask_attify, lookup_vendor, explain_provenance, get_program_status · Public sink: get_index, get_traction_report, get_monthly_verdict, get_agent_outcomes, compare_my_agents, get_renewal_packs, get_badge_embed, list_traction_reports, get_ingest_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
